description: Maps Congress.gov API response field names to canonical SnapMetadata field names. Used by the PoliSnap mining normaliser to populate typed metadata without manual field mapping per snap.

_notes._billTypePrefix: Combine bill.type + bill.number to produce canonical billId: e.g. 'hr' + '1041' → 'H.R.1041', 'sjres' + '185' → 'S.J.Res.185'
_notes._billTitle: Use for SnapMetadata.description or element Header.Bill data.billTitle
_notes._currentMember: Boolean — use to filter active vs. historical members when populating snap metadata
_notes.contentKey_convention: Use 'bill:{billId}' pattern: e.g. 'bill:H.R.1041'. Populate SnapMetadata.ContentKey for upsert detection.
